title: Fix settings review library profile diff
summary: Settings Save review now renders structured LibraryProfiles values with profile/override summaries and before/after override detail instead of JavaScript object stringification.
reason: LibraryProfiles save previews could show [object Object] for both current and new values, hiding nested overrides such as SizeGuardMode=fallback_remux.
behavior_before: The save review dialog formatted LibraryProfiles arrays through generic array join logic, so arrays of profile objects displayed as [object Object], [object Object].
behavior_after: The save review dialog summarizes LibraryProfiles profile counts, IDs/names, explicit overrides, and per-profile deltas; SizeGuardMode=fallback_remux is visible before confirmation.
tests_added: tests/webview/test_webview_browser_settings_launch_smoke.py covers LibraryProfiles save-review rendering for SizeGuardMode=fallback_remux and rejects [object Object].
tests/webview/test_webview_settings_libraries.py adds static coverage for LibraryProfiles save-review formatter wiring.
